lines: R E F E R E N C E
Set the timer as a plain
cycle for the stage, first pulse after sunrise, last well before dark. Small, frequent
(that's when the plant drinks most; don't skip the middle of the day).
Enter the stage's interval & minutes, then leave it. Don't re-program for one rainy day —
free-draining coir sheds the extra. Check run-off ~2–3×/week (aim 15–20%); only adjust
the whole schedule if it drifts for several days. If the timer has no day/night setting, choose
the start so pulses land in daylight — avoid watering into the night.
